|joke=The whole lore is Chewbacca's roar spelled out, and one game text option will "Scare off (lose) one 'mouse' droid on table": in ''Star Wars'' Chewbacca roars at a mouse droid on the Death Star, and it squeals and races away.<ref name="wook-g7">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/MSE-6-G735Y MSE-6-G735Y], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260124100120/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/MSE-6-G735Y Internet Archive], 24 January 2026.</ref> The mouse droid's own card, [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]], ends "Easily frightened." It is part of the running gag of cards that print alien speech and sounds without a translation. See [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Jokes]].
